## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ManageProjects`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `manage-projects`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ManageProjects**.

## Step 2: Create a project

1. On the **All Projects** page, select **+ Create Project**.
2. <!-- manual: Fill in the Create a Project form: -->
3. Select **Create**.

## Step 3: Edit a project

1. On the **All Projects** page, select **Edit** icon on a project.
2. <!-- manual: Update the Display Name or Description. The Name slug is read-only after creation. -->
3. Select **Save**.
